observed_rules: ACCKPNGPBHC captures several existing managers and values, calls the existing clone/training manager's rebirth hook, then replaces the central PFBFLAJEGBI state object with a newly constructed instance (EIEEGDPHEPO.cs:4740-4900).

After replacement, selected manager objects and selected subcollections are assigned back, while inspected clone records have per-run values GEHGBKPHENJ, GIBPIPCKDNN, JNMLPIDLJBN zeroed and PNCGEDLCMHJ cleared (EIEEGDPHEPO.cs:4780-4885).
The routine records the rebirth count to statistics and invokes post-transition manager recalculations before returning (EIEEGDPHEPO.cs:5270-5316).

state_transition.limits: The state class has many fields and this is not an exhaustive retained/reset inventory. Do not treat absence from this table as evidence that a field resets or persists.

enrollment_and_modifier: The challenge metadata names it No Training Challenge and says it is unlocked after maxing Monster Queen Challenges; the same case states the objective is to beat P.Baal V20 (Mew) with training, skills and might disabled (OHCPKHJMFOO.cs:761-770). This is the metadata description, not an independently traced unlock UI gate.

The metadata describes a +5% per completed challenge increase to Physical and Mystic obtained from Skills and Physical trainings, with an additional stated effect on Mystic Regen + Might at 20 completions (OHCPKHJMFOO.cs:761-770). Statistics rendering computes the first multiplier as min(100 + 5 * completed NTC count, 200) percent (DNBDCFFIEDG.cs:5858-5859).

HJDMNBANOMG.AKLNHKMJGFJ clears challenge-run counters, applies the common rebirth routine with the challenge object, and then stores the challenge enum as active state (HJDMNBANOMG.cs:241-273). This establishes the generic challenge enrollment transition, not an NTC-specific menu click path.
restriction_and_rejection: NLHFJIOHPDO.BPMABPHBKOP returns immediately when the active challenge is NTC, before applying its GEHGBKPHENJ-weighted progress update (NLHFJIOHPDO.cs:766-772). The implementation object is shared/inherited; its precise gameplay category and all affected actions were not established, so this is a concrete method-level restriction only.
observed_rules: If the active challenge type satisfies OHCPKHJMFOO.IEHJKNGNNGE, the transition reports that rebirth lost the No Rebirth Challenge and calls MLNFJDJIDDA.KOFIDBHKBIG with the current state (EIEEGDPHEPO.cs:4615-4622). The predicate's full enum coverage was not reviewed, so this is not generalized to all challenges.

For two specific challenge enum values, the transition adds challenge-derived values to run-state fields before completing the reset (EIEEGDPHEPO.cs:4623-4635). Their obfuscated enum names are preserved rather than semantically relabeled.
The transition's optional challenge argument is forwarded by HJDMNBANOMG callers; exact enrollment restrictions and completion rewards were not traced in this note (HJDMNBANOMG.cs:204-266).
challenge_consequences.modifier_formula: NTC training/skill stat gain = min(100% + 5% * completed_NTC_count, 200%) as displayed by DNBDCFFIEDG. Additional 20-completion Mystic Regen + Might effect is described in challenge metadata but its full consumer formula was not traced.
challenge_consequences.failure_path: The NTC restriction path is a rejected progress update: BPMABPHBKOP exits before incrementing its progress accumulator when NTC is active. Full challenge loss/timeout behavior was not traced.
challenge_consequences.completion_path: Completion accounting and reward application were not traced to their commit point. The metadata and statistics getter expose the resulting completion count and modifier only.
